items.title: Ray Drummond interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 9, 2003
items.q: INTERVIEWER: My name is Monk Rowe and we are filming in Toronto for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive.

ctx.x: Ray was interviewed in Toronto, Canada on January 9, 2003 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and we are filming in Toronto for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. It’s a real pleasure to have Ray Drummond with me here, composer and bassist, band leader, and keeper of a neat website.
Thank you. I wasn’t expecting that. I thought you’d say professor next. Budding professor.
